stench.descES: Puede amedrentar al rival al atacarlo debido al mal olor que emana.
stench.descEN: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

damp.descES: Aumenta la humedad del entorno y evita que se puedan utilizar movimientos explosivos, tales como Autodestrucción.
damp.descEN: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.

drizzle.descES: Hace que llueva al entrar en combate.
drizzle.descEN: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

battle-armor.descES: La robusta coraza que lo protege bloquea los golpes críticos.
battle-armor.descEN: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

sturdy.descES: Evita que el rival pueda debilitarlo de un solo golpe cuando tiene los PS al máximo. También evita los movimientos fulminantes.
sturdy.descEN: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

speed-boost.descES: Aumenta su Velocidad en cada turno.
speed-boost.descEN: The Pokémon's Speed stat is boosted every turn.

limber.descES: Evita ser paralizado gracias a la flexibilidad de su cuerpo.
limber.descEN: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

volt-absorb.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
volt-absorb.descEN: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

static.descES: La electricidad estática que lo envuelve puede paralizar al mínimo contacto.
static.descEN: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

sand-veil.descES: Aumenta su Evasión durante las tormentas de arena.
sand-veil.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

water-absorb.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Agua, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
water-absorb.descEN: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

oblivious.descES: Su indiferencia evita que sea provocado o caiga presa del enamoramiento.
oblivious.descEN: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

compound-eyes.descES: Aumenta la precisión de sus movimientos.
compound-eyes.descEN: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

insomnia.descES: Su resistencia al sueño le impide quedarse dormido.
insomnia.descEN: The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.

immunity.descES: Su sistema inmunitario evita el envenenamiento.
immunity.descEN: The Pokémon's immune system prevents it from being poisoned.

cloud-nine.descES: Anula todos los efectos del tiempo atmosférico.

color-change.descES: Adopta el tipo del último movimiento del que es blanco.
color-change.descEN: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.

flash-fire.descES: Si le alcanza algún movimiento de tipo Fuego, potencia sus propios movimientos de dicho tipo.
flash-fire.descEN: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

shield-dust.descES: El polvo de escamas que lo envuelve lo protege de los efectos secundarios de los ataques recibidos.
shield-dust.descEN: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

suction-cups.descES: Sus ventosas se aferran al suelo, con lo cual anula movimientos y objetos que fuerzan el relevo.
suction-cups.descEN: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

intimidate.descES: Al entrar en combate amilana al rival de tal manera que su Ataque disminuye.
intimidate.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

own-tempo.descES: Como le gusta hacer las cosas a su manera, los rivales no logran confundirlo.
own-tempo.descEN: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

shadow-tag.descES: Impide que el enemigo huya o sea cambiado por otro.
shadow-tag.descEN: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

wonder-guard.descES: Gracias a un poder misterioso, solo le hacen daño los movimientos supereficaces.
wonder-guard.descEN: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.

rough-skin.descES: Hiere con su piel áspera al rival que lo ataque con un movimiento de contacto.
rough-skin.descEN: The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.

levitate.descES: Su capacidad de flotar sobre el suelo le proporciona inmunidad frente a los movimientos de tipo Tierra.
levitate.descEN: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

effect-spore.descES: Puede dormir, envenenar o paralizar al Pokémon con el que entre en contacto al recibir un ataque.
effect-spore.descEN: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on the attacker.

natural-cure.descES: Cura sus problemas de estado al cambiarse con otro Pokémon.
natural-cure.descEN: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.

synchronize.descES: Contagia el envenenamiento, las quemaduras o la parálisis al Pokémon que le cause ese estado.
synchronize.descEN: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

clear-body.descES: Evita que bajen sus características a causa de movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon.
clear-body.descEN: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

lightning-rod.descES: Atrae y neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico, que además le suben el Ataque Especial.
lightning-rod.descEN: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

serene-grace.descES: Aumenta la probabilidad de que los movimientos causen efectos secundarios.
serene-grace.descEN: Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.

swift-swim.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

illuminate.descES: Aumenta la probabilidad de encontrar Pokémon al iluminar el entorno.
illuminate.descEN: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.

chlorophyll.descES: Sube su Velocidad cuando hace sol.
chlorophyll.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

trace.descES: Al entrar en combate copia la habilidad del rival.
trace.descEN: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.

huge-power.descES: Duplica la potencia de sus ataques físicos.

inner-focus.descES: Gracias a su profunda concentración, no se amedrenta ante los ataques del rival.
inner-focus.descEN: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

poison-point.descEN: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

magma-armor.descES: Gracias al magma candente que lo envuelve, no puede ser congelado.
magma-armor.descEN: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.

water-veil.descES: Evita las quemaduras gracias a la capa de agua que lo envuelve.
water-veil.descEN: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.

magnet-pull.descES: Su magnetismo atrae a los Pokémon de tipo Acero y les impide huir.
magnet-pull.descEN: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.

soundproof.descES: Su aislamiento acústico lo protege de movimientos que usan sonido.
soundproof.descEN: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

rain-dish.descES: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando llueve.
rain-dish.descEN: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

sand-stream.descES: Crea una tormenta de arena al entrar en combate.
sand-stream.descEN: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

pressure.descES: Presiona al rival para que sus PP se acaben antes.
pressure.descEN: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

thick-fat.descES: Gracias a la gruesa capa de grasa que lo protege, reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de ataques de tipo Fuego o Hielo.
thick-fat.descEN: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

flame-body.descEN: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

early-bird.descES: Si se duerme, tardará la mitad de tiempo en despertarse.
early-bird.descEN: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

run-away.descES: Puede escaparse de todos los Pokémon salvajes.
run-away.descEN: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

hyper-cutter.descES: Evita que el rival le baje el Ataque.
hyper-cutter.descEN: The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

keen-eye.descES: Su aguda vista evita que le disminuya la Precisión.
keen-eye.descEN: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

truant.descES: Al ejecutar un movimiento, descansará en el turno siguiente.
truant.descEN: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.

pickup.descES: Puede recoger objetos que el rival haya usado, o bien otros que encuentre en plena aventura.
pickup.descEN: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

hustle.descES: Aumenta su Ataque, pero reduce su Precisión.
hustle.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.

cute-charm.descES: Puede causar enamoramiento al rival que lo toque.
cute-charm.descEN: The Pokémon may infatuate attackers that make direct contact with it.

plus.descES: Potencia su Ataque Especial si un Pokémon aliado tiene la habilidad Más o Menos.
plus.descEN: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

minus.descES: Potencia su Ataque Especial si un Pokémon aliado tiene la habilidad Más o Menos.
minus.descEN: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

forecast.descES: Cambia a tipo Agua, Fuego o Hielo en función del tiempo atmosférico.
forecast.descEN: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.

sticky-hold.descES: Los objetos se quedan pegados a su cuerpo, por lo que no pueden robárselos.
sticky-hold.descEN: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

shed-skin.descES: Puede curar sus problemas de estado al mudar la piel.
shed-skin.descEN: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

guts.descES: Si sufre un problema de estado, se viene arriba y aumenta su Ataque.
guts.descEN: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

liquid-ooze.descES: Exuda una sustancia tóxica de intenso hedor que hiere a quienes intentan drenarle PS.
liquid-ooze.descEN: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.

marvel-scale.descES: Sube su Defensa si sufre un problema de estado.
marvel-scale.descEN: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost its Defense stat if it has a status condition.

overgrow.descES: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Planta cuando le quedan pocos PS.
overgrow.descEN: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

blaze.descES: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Fuego cuando le quedan pocos PS.
blaze.descEN: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

torrent.descES: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Agua cuando le quedan pocos PS.
torrent.descEN: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

swarm.descES: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Bicho cuando le quedan pocos PS.
swarm.descEN: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

rock-head.descES: No puede dañarse con sus propios movimientos.
rock-head.descEN: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

arena-trap.descEN: Prevents opposing Pokémon from fleeing from battle.

drought.descES: Cuando entra en combate, el tiempo pasa a ser soleado.
drought.descEN: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

vital-spirit.descES: Su determinación le impide quedarse dormido.
vital-spirit.descEN: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

white-smoke.descES: El humo blanco que lo protege evita que otros Pokémon le bajen las características.
white-smoke.descEN: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

pure-power.descES: Duplica la potencia de sus ataques físicos gracias al yoga.
pure-power.descEN: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

air-lock.descES: Neutraliza todos los efectos del tiempo atmosférico.

shell-armor.descES: La robusta coraza que lo protege bloquea los golpes críticos.
shell-armor.descEN: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

tangled-feet.descES: Sube su Evasión si está confuso.
tangled-feet.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.

motor-drive.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico, le sube la Velocidad en vez de sufrir daño.
motor-drive.descEN: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.

rivalry.descES: Si el objetivo es del mismo sexo, su competitividad le lleva a infligir más daño. Si es del sexo contrario, en cambio, el daño será menor.
rivalry.descEN: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.

steadfast.descES: Cada vez que se amedrenta sube su Velocidad, debido a su voluntad inquebrantable.
steadfast.descEN: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.

snow-cloak.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.

gluttony.descES: Cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad, engulle la baya que normalmente solo se comería cuando le quedasen pocos PS.
gluttony.descEN: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.

anger-point.descES: Si recibe un golpe crítico, monta en cólera y sube su Ataque hasta el máximo.
anger-point.descEN: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

unburden.descES: Sube su Velocidad si usa o pierde el objeto que lleva.
unburden.descEN: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

simple.descES: Duplica los cambios en las características.
simple.descEN: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon's stat changes.

heatproof.descES: Su cuerpo, resistente al calor, reduce a la mitad el daño recibido por movimientos de tipo Fuego.
heatproof.descEN: The Pokémon's heatproof body halves the damage taken from Fire-type moves.

dry-skin.descES: Pierde PS si hace sol y los recupera si llueve o recibe un movimiento de tipo Agua. Los movimientos de tipo Fuego, por su parte, le hacen más daño de lo normal.
dry-skin.descEN: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

download.descES: Compara la Defensa y la Defensa Especial del rival para ver cuál es inferior y aumenta su propio Ataque o Ataque Especial según sea lo más eficaz.
download.descEN: The Pokémon compares an opposing Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever will be more effective.

iron-fist.descES: Aumenta la potencia de los puñetazos.

poison-heal.descES: Si resulta envenenado, recupera PS en vez de perderlos.
poison-heal.descEN: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

adaptability.descES: Potencia aún más los movimientos cuyo tipo coincida con el suyo.
adaptability.descEN: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.

hydration.descES: Cura los problemas de estado si está lloviendo.
hydration.descEN: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions in rain.

skill-link.descES: Ejecuta siempre los movimientos múltiples con el número máximo de golpes.
skill-link.descEN: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

solar-power.descES: Si hace sol, aumenta su Ataque Especial, pero pierde PS en cada turno.
solar-power.descEN: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.

quick-feet.descES: Aumenta la Velocidad si sufre problemas de estado.
quick-feet.descEN: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.

normalize.descES: Hace que todos sus movimientos se vuelvan de tipo Normal y aumenten ligeramente su potencia.
normalize.descEN: All the Pokémon’s moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

sniper.descES: Potencia los golpes críticos que asesta aún más de lo normal.
sniper.descEN: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.

magic-guard.descEN: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

no-guard.descES: Al quedar ambos expuestos, tanto sus movimientos como los del rival acertarán siempre.
no-guard.descEN: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.

stall.descES: Ejecuta su movimiento tras todos los demás.
stall.descEN: The Pokémon is always the last to use its moves.

technician.descEN: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.

leaf-guard.descES: Evita los problemas de estado si hace sol.
leaf-guard.descEN: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.

klutz.descEN: The Pokémon can't use any held items.

mold-breaker.descES: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
mold-breaker.descEN: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

aftermath.descES: Daña al agresor que le ha dado el golpe de gracia con un movimiento de contacto.
aftermath.descEN: Damages the attacker if it knocks out the Pokémon with a move that makes direct contact.

super-luck.descES: Su buena suerte aumenta la probabilidad de asestar golpes críticos.
super-luck.descEN: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.

anticipation.descES: Prevé los movimientos peligrosos del rival.
anticipation.descEN: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.

forewarn.descES: Indica el movimiento más potente del rival al entrar en combate.
forewarn.descEN: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

unaware.descES: Pasa por alto las mejoras en las características del rival al atacar.
unaware.descEN: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.

tinted-lens.descES: Potencia los movimientos que no son muy eficaces, que infligen ahora un daño normal.
tinted-lens.descEN: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.

filter.descES: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
filter.descEN: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

slow-start.descES: Baja a la mitad su Ataque y su Velocidad durante cinco turnos.
slow-start.descEN: For five turns, the Pokémon's Attack and Speed stats are halved.

scrappy.descES: Puede alcanzar a Pokémon de tipo Fantasma con movimientos de tipo Normal o Lucha.
scrappy.descEN: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

storm-drain.descES: Atrae y neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Agua, que además le suben el Ataque Especial.
storm-drain.descEN: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

ice-body.descES: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando hay tormentas de granizo.
ice-body.descEN: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

solid-rock.descES: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
solid-rock.descEN: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

snow-warning.descES: Invoca una tormenta de granizo al entrar en combate.
snow-warning.descEN: The Pokémon makes it snow when it enters a battle.

frisk.descES: Puede ver el objeto que lleva el rival al entrar en combate.
frisk.descEN: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.

honey-gather.descES: Puede que encuentre Miel una vez concluido el combate.
honey-gather.descEN: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.

reckless.descES: Potencia los movimientos que también dañan al usuario.
reckless.descEN: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

multitype.descES: Cambia su tipo al de la tabla o al del Cristal Z que lleve.
multitype.descEN: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the plate it holds.

flower-gift.descES: Si hace sol, aumenta su Ataque y su Defensa Especial, así como los de sus aliados.
flower-gift.descEN: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of itself and allies in harsh sunlight.

bad-dreams.descES: Inflige daño a cualquier rival que esté dormido.
bad-dreams.descEN: Damages opposing Pokémon that are asleep.

sheer-force.descES: Sube la potencia de sus movimientos en detrimento de los efectos secundarios, que se ven anulados.
sheer-force.descEN: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

pickpocket.descES: Si el rival usa un movimiento de contacto al atacar, le roba el objeto.
pickpocket.descEN: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.

contrary.descES: Invierte los cambios en las características: bajan cuando les toca subir y suben cuando les toca bajar.
contrary.descEN: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them—and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.

unnerve.descES: Pone nervioso al rival y le impide usar bayas.
unnerve.descEN: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

defiant.descES: Sube mucho su Ataque cuando el rival le baja las características.
defiant.descEN: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.

defeatist.descES: Se debilita tanto cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad que su Ataque y su Ataque Especial bajan.
defeatist.descEN: Halves the Pokémon’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP becomes half or less.

cursed-body.descES: Puede anular el movimiento usado en su contra.
cursed-body.descEN: May disable a move that has dealt damage to the Pokémon.

healer.descES: A veces cura los problemas de estado de un aliado.
healer.descEN: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.

friend-guard.descES: Reduce el daño que sufren los aliados.

weak-armor.descES: Al recibir daño de un ataque físico, le baja la Defensa, pero le sube mucho la Velocidad.
weak-armor.descEN: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.

multiscale.descES: Reduce el daño que sufre si sus PS están al máximo.
multiscale.descEN: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

light-metal.descES: Reduce a la mitad su peso.

toxic-boost.descES: Aumenta la potencia de sus ataques físicos cuando está envenenado.
toxic-boost.descEN: Powers up physical moves when the Pokémon is poisoned.

flare-boost.descES: Aumenta la potencia de sus ataques especiales cuando sufre quemaduras.
flare-boost.descEN: Powers up special moves when the Pokémon is burned.

telepathy.descES: Elude los ataques de los aliados durante el combate.
telepathy.descEN: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

harvest.descES: Puede reutilizar varias veces una misma baya.
harvest.descEN: May create another Berry after one is used.

moody.descES: Una característica le sube mucho en cada turno, pero le baja otra.
moody.descEN: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.

overcoat.descES: No le afectan las tormentas de arena, el granizo y los movimientos con polvos.
overcoat.descEN: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.

poison-touch.descES: Puede envenenar al objetivo con solo tocarlo.
poison-touch.descEN: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.

regenerator.descES: Recupera unos pocos PS al ser cambiado por otro Pokémon.
regenerator.descEN: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.

big-pecks.descES: Impide que el rival le baje la Defensa.
big-pecks.descEN: Prevents the Pokémon from having its Defense stat lowered.

sand-rush.descES: Aumenta su Velocidad durante las tormentas de arena.
sand-rush.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.

wonder-skin.descES: Presenta una mayor resistencia ante los movimientos de estado.
wonder-skin.descEN: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.

analytic.descES: Aumenta la potencia de su movimiento si es el último en atacar.
analytic.descEN: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.

illusion.descES: Adopta el aspecto del último Pokémon del equipo al entrar en combate para desconcertar al rival.
illusion.descEN: The Pokémon fools opponents by entering battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its Trainer's party.

imposter.descES: Se transforma en el Pokémon que tiene enfrente.
imposter.descEN: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.

infiltrator.descES: Ataca sorteando la barrera o el sustituto del rival.
infiltrator.descEN: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.

mummy.descES: Contagia la habilidad Momia al rival que entre en contacto con él.
mummy.descEN: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.

moxie.descES: Al debilitar a un objetivo, su confianza se refuerza de tal manera que aumenta su Ataque.
moxie.descEN: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

justified.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Siniestro, aumenta el Ataque debido a su integridad.
justified.descEN: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

rattled.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Siniestro, Bicho o Fantasma, el miedo hace que le suba la Velocidad.
rattled.descEN: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.

sap-sipper.descES: Neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Planta y sube su Ataque.
sap-sipper.descEN: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.

magic-bounce.descES: Puede devolver los movimientos de estado lanzados por el rival, sin verse afectado por ellos.
magic-bounce.descEN: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.

prankster.descES: Sus movimientos de estado tienen prioridad alta.
prankster.descEN: Gives priority to the Pokémon's status moves.

sand-force.descES: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Tierra, Acero y Roca durante las tormentas de arena.
sand-force.descEN: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

iron-barbs.descES: Inflige daño al rival si este le golpea con un movimiento de contacto.
iron-barbs.descEN: Inflicts damage on the attacker upon contact with iron barbs.

victory-star.descES: Sube su Precisión y la de sus aliados.
victory-star.descEN: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.

zen-mode.descES: Cambia de forma si sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad.
zen-mode.descEN: Changes the Pokémon’s shape when HP is half or less.

turboblaze.descES: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
turboblaze.descEN: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

teravolt.descES: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
teravolt.descEN: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

aroma-veil.descES: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados de ataques que impiden elegir movimientos.
aroma-veil.descEN: Protects the Pokémon and its allies from effects that prevent the use of moves.

flower-veil.descES: Evita que los Pokémon de tipo Planta aliados sufran problemas de estado o que les bajen sus características.
flower-veil.descEN: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.

cheek-pouch.descES: Recupera PS al comer cualquier baya.
cheek-pouch.descEN: The Pokémon's HP is restored when it eats any Berry, in addition to the Berry's usual effect.

protean.descES: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.
protean.descEN: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

fur-coat.descES: Reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de ataques físicos del rival.
fur-coat.descEN: Halves the damage from physical moves.

magician.descES: Roba el objeto del Pokémon al que alcance con un movimiento.
magician.descEN: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

bulletproof.descES: No le afectan las bombas ni algunos proyectiles.
bulletproof.descEN: Protects the Pokémon from ball and bomb moves.

competitive.descES: Aumenta mucho su Ataque Especial cuando el rival le baja cualquiera de sus características.
competitive.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.

strong-jaw.descES: Su robusta mandíbula le confiere una mordedura potente.
strong-jaw.descEN: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.

refrigerate.descES: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Hielo y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
refrigerate.descEN: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

sweet-veil.descES: No cae dormido y evita también que sus aliados se duerman.
sweet-veil.descEN: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.

stance-change.descES: Adopta la Forma Filo al lanzar un ataque, o bien la Forma Escudo si usa el movimiento Escudo Real.
stance-change.descEN: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.

gale-wings.descES: Da prioridad a los movimientos de tipo Volador si sus PS están al máximo.
gale-wings.descEN: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.

grass-pelt.descES: Aumenta su Defensa si hay un campo de hierba en el terreno de combate.
grass-pelt.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat on Grassy Terrain.

mega-launcher.descES: Aumenta la potencia de algunos movimientos de pulsos y auras.

symbiosis.descES: Pasa su objeto a un aliado que ya haya utilizado el suyo.
symbiosis.descEN: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.

tough-claws.descES: Aumenta la potencia de los movimientos de contacto.
tough-claws.descEN: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

pixilate.descES: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Hada y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
pixilate.descEN: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

gooey.descES: Baja la Velocidad del rival cuando este le ataca con un movimiento de contacto.
gooey.descEN: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

aerilate.descES: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Volador y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
aerilate.descEN: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

parental-bond.descES: Une fuerzas con su cría y ataca dos veces.

dark-aura.descES: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos de tipo Siniestro.
dark-aura.descEN: Powers up each Pokémon’s Dark-type moves.

fairy-aura.descES: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos de tipo Hada.
fairy-aura.descEN: Powers up each Pokémon’s Fairy-type moves.

aura-break.descES: Invierte los efectos de las auras, por lo que baja la potencia de ciertos movimientos en vez de subirla.
aura-break.descEN: The effects of “Aura” Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.

primordial-sea.descES: Altera el clima para anular los ataques de tipo Fuego.
primordial-sea.descEN: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.

desolate-land.descES: Altera el clima para anular los ataques de tipo Agua.
desolate-land.descEN: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.

delta-stream.descES: Altera el clima para anular las vulnerabilidades del tipo Volador.
delta-stream.descEN: The Pokémon changes the weather to eliminate all of the Flying type’s weaknesses.

stamina.descES: Aumenta su Defensa al recibir un ataque.
stamina.descEN: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

wimp-out.descES: Se asusta y abandona el terreno de combate cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad.
wimp-out.descEN: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

emergency-exit.descES: Abandona el terreno de combate cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad para evitar males mayores.
emergency-exit.descEN: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

water-compaction.descES: Aumenta mucho su Defensa si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Agua.
water-compaction.descEN: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.

shields-down.descES: Rompe su coraza cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad y adopta una forma ofensiva.
shields-down.descEN: When its HP drops to half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.

merciless.descES: Hace que sus movimientos asesten siempre un golpe crítico si el rival está envenenado.
merciless.descEN: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

stakeout.descES: Si el objetivo de su ataque es sustituido por otro, duplica el daño que infligirá.
stakeout.descEN: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.

water-bubble.descES: Reduce el daño que le provocan los movimientos de tipo Fuego y es inmune a las quemaduras.
water-bubble.descEN: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.

steelworker.descES: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero.

berserk.descES: Aumenta su Ataque Especial si sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad debido a algún ataque.
berserk.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to drop to half or less.

slush-rush.descES: Aumenta su Velocidad si está granizando.
slush-rush.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.

long-reach.descES: Puede usar cualquier movimiento sin entrar en contacto con el rival.
long-reach.descEN: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

liquid-voice.descES: Hace que todos sus movimientos que usan sonido pasen a ser de tipo Agua.

triage.descES: Da prioridad a los movimientos que restauran PS.
triage.descEN: Gives priority to the Pokémon's healing moves.

galvanize.descES: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Eléctrico y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
galvanize.descEN: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

surge-surfer.descES: Duplica su Velocidad si hay un campo eléctrico en el terreno de combate.
surge-surfer.descEN: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

schooling.descES: Forma bancos con sus congéneres cuando tiene muchos PS, lo cual le otorga más fuerza. Cuando le quedan pocos PS, el banco se dispersa.
schooling.descEN: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.

disguise.descES: Puede eludir un ataque valiéndose de la tela que le cubre el cuerpo una vez por combate.
disguise.descEN: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

battle-bond.descES: Al derrotar a un rival, los vínculos con su Entrenador se refuerzan y se convierte en Greninja Ash. Su Shuriken de Agua también se ve potenciado.
battle-bond.descEN: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, its bond with its Trainer is strengthened, and its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted.

power-construct.descES: Cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad, las células se reagrupan y adopta su Forma Completa.
power-construct.descEN: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.

corrosion.descES: Puede envenenar incluso a rivales de tipo Acero o Veneno.
corrosion.descEN: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.

comatose.descES: No despierta jamás de su profundo letargo e incluso ataca dormido.
comatose.descEN: The Pokémon is always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack while in its sleeping state.

queenly-majesty.descES: Intimida al objetivo y le impide usar movimientos con prioridad.
queenly-majesty.descEN: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

innards-out.descES: Al caer debilitado, inflige al rival un daño equivalente a los PS que le quedaran.
innards-out.descEN: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.

dancer.descES: Puede copiar inmediatamente cualquier movimiento de baile que haya usado otro Pokémon presente en el combate.
dancer.descEN: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.

battery.descES: Potencia los ataques especiales de los aliados.
battery.descEN: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.

fluffy.descES: Reduce a la mitad el daño provocado por los movimientos de contacto, pero duplica el infligido por los de tipo Fuego.
fluffy.descEN: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

soul-heart.descES: Aumenta su Ataque Especial cada vez que un Pokémon cae debilitado.
soul-heart.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat every time another Pokémon faints.

dazzling.descES: Desconcierta al rival y le impide utilizar movimientos con prioridad en su contra.
dazzling.descEN: The Pokémon dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

tangling-hair.descES: Baja la Velocidad del rival cuando este le ataca con un movimiento de contacto.
tangling-hair.descEN: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

power-of-alchemy.descES: Reacciona copiando la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.
power-of-alchemy.descEN: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

receiver.descES: Adquiere la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.
receiver.descEN: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

beast-boost.descES: Si derrota a un rival en ese turno, aumenta su característica más fuerte.
beast-boost.descEN: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.

electric-surge.descES: Crea un campo eléctrico al entrar en combate.
electric-surge.descEN: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

rks-system.descES: Cambia su tipo según el disco que lleve instalado.
rks-system.descEN: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.

psychic-surge.descES: Crea un campo psíquico al entrar en combate.
psychic-surge.descEN: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

misty-surge.descES: Crea un campo de niebla al entrar en combate.
misty-surge.descEN: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

grassy-surge.descES: Crea un campo de hierba al entrar en combate.
grassy-surge.descEN: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

full-metal-body.descES: Evita que bajen sus características a causa de movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon.
full-metal-body.descEN: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.

shadow-shield.descES: Reduce el daño que sufre si sus PS están al máximo.
shadow-shield.descEN: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

prism-armor.descES: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
prism-armor.descEN: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

neuroforce.descEN: Powers up moves that are super effective.

intrepid-sword.descES: Aumenta su Ataque al entrar en combate.
intrepid-sword.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

dauntless-shield.descES: Aumenta su Defensa al entrar en combate.
dauntless-shield.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

libero.descES: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.
libero.descEN: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

ball-fetch.descES: Si no lleva equipado ningún objeto, recupera la Poké Ball del primer intento de captura fallido.
ball-fetch.descEN: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.

cotton-down.descES: Al ser alcanzado por un ataque, suelta una pelusa de algodón que reduce la Velocidad de todos los demás Pokémon.
cotton-down.descEN: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.

propeller-tail.descES: Impide que el rival pueda atraer ataques hacia sí mismo por efecto de su habilidad o sus movimientos.
propeller-tail.descEN: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

mirror-armor.descES: Refleja los efectos que reducen las características.
mirror-armor.descEN: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

gulp-missile.descES: Tras usar Surf o Buceo, emerge con una presa en la boca. Al recibir daño, ataca escupiéndola al rival.
gulp-missile.descEN: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

stalwart.descES: Impide que el rival pueda atraer ataques hacia sí mismo por efecto de su habilidad o sus movimientos.
stalwart.descEN: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

steam-engine.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Fuego o Agua, le sube muchísimo la Velocidad.
steam-engine.descEN: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

punk-rock.descES: Potencia los movimientos que usan sonido y reduce a la mitad el daño que le infligen dichos movimientos.
punk-rock.descEN: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

sand-spit.descES: Provoca una tormenta de arena al recibir un ataque.
sand-spit.descEN: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

ice-scales.descES: Las gélidas escamas que protegen su cuerpo reducen a la mitad el daño que le infligen los ataques especiales.
ice-scales.descEN: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

ripen.descES: Hace madurar las bayas, por lo que duplica sus efectos.
ripen.descEN: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

ice-face.descES: Absorbe el daño de un ataque físico con el hielo de la cabeza, tras lo cual cambia de forma. El hielo se regenerará la próxima vez que granice.
ice-face.descEN: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.

power-spot.descES: Potencia los movimientos de los Pokémon adyacentes.
power-spot.descEN: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

mimicry.descES: Cambia su tipo según el campo que haya en el terreno de combate.
mimicry.descEN: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

screen-cleaner.descES: Anula los efectos de Pantalla de Luz, Reflejo y Velo Aurora tanto de rivales como de aliados al entrar en combate.
screen-cleaner.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

steely-spirit.descES: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero de los aliados.
steely-spirit.descEN: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.

perish-body.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de contacto, se debilitará al cabo de 3 turnos, así como su agresor, a menos que abandonen el terreno de combate.
perish-body.descEN: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

wandering-spirit.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de contacto, intercambia su habilidad con la del agresor.
wandering-spirit.descEN: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

gorilla-tactics.descES: Potencia su Ataque, pero solo puede usar el primer movimiento escogido.
gorilla-tactics.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

neutralizing-gas.descES: Anula los efectos de las habilidades de los demás Pokémon presentes mientras esté en el terreno de combate.
neutralizing-gas.descEN: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

pastel-veil.descES: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados del envenenamiento.
pastel-veil.descEN: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.

quick-draw.descES: A veces, puede atacar el primero.
quick-draw.descEN: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

hunger-switch.descES: Alterna entre su Forma Saciada y Forma Voraz al final de cada turno.
hunger-switch.descEN: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

unseen-fist.descES: Si usa un movimiento de contacto, puede infligir daño al objetivo aunque este se proteja.
unseen-fist.descEN: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

curious-medicine.descES: Al entrar en combate, rezuma una substancia medicinal por la caracola que revierte los cambios en las características de los aliados.
curious-medicine.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

transistor.descES: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico.

dragons-maw.descES: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón.

grim-neigh.descES: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho aterrador y aumenta su Ataque Especial.
grim-neigh.descEN: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

chilling-neigh.descES: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho gélido y aumenta su Ataque.
chilling-neigh.descEN: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

as-one-glastrier.descES: El Pokémon tiene dos habilidades: Relincho Blanco de Glastrier y Nerviosismo de Calyrex.
as-one-glastrier.descEN: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Glastrier's Chilling Neigh Ability.

as-one-spectrier.descES: El Pokémon tiene dos habilidades: Relincho Negro de Spectrier y Nerviosismo de Calyrex.
as-one-spectrier.descEN: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Spectrier's Grim Neigh Ability.

lingering-aroma.descEN: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

seed-sower.descEN: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

thermal-exchange.descEN: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

purifying-salt.descEN: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

anger-shell.descEN: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

well-baked-body.descEN: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

wind-rider.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

guard-dog.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

wind-power.descEN: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

zero-to-hero.descEN: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

commander.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

electromorphosis.descEN: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

protosynthesis.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

quark-drive.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

good-as-gold.descEN: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

vessel-of-ruin.descEN: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

sword-of-ruin.descEN: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

tablets-of-ruin.descEN: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

beads-of-ruin.descEN: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

orichalcum-pulse.descEN: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

hadron-engine.descEN: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

opportunist.descEN: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

cud-chew.descEN: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

supreme-overlord.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

toxic-debris.descEN: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

costar.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.

armor-tail.descEN: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

earth-eater.descEN: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

mycelium-might.descEN: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

minds-eye.descEN: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves

supersweet-syrup.descEN: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

hospitality.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP

toxic-chain.descEN: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move

embody-aspect.descEN: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Mask to shine and one of the Pokémon's stats to be boosted.

tera-shell.descEN: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

tera-shift.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

teraform-zero.descEN: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

poison-puppeteer.descEN: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

piercing-drill.descEN: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

dragonize.descEN: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

mega-sol.descEN: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

spicy-spray.descEN: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

eelevate.descEN: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

fire-mane.descEN: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

aura-guard.descEN: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact. Moves affected by Long Reach which make contact will deal regular damage.
